name: @futuremagic/creatures
description: Procedural creatures for three.js games: a species grown from a seed (ten body plans, oddities bought with strangeness), its rest skeleton and flesh primitives, one smooth skinned mesh by surface nets with its coat painted per vertex, a rig that poses it every frame (gaits, planted feet, springs, actions), and the node materials (TSL) for its flesh and eyes. Pure parts run in workers. From Dunfinity (after Norgo).
